info.name: Campus Lost and Found Portal
info.description:
API test collection for the Campus Lost and Found Portal.

Set baseUrl in the environment (default http://localhost:3000), then run the folders in order:
authentication saves the tokens, item creation saves itemId, and the claim folder saves claimId and pickupCode for the follow-up requests.

42 requests covering successful calls, invalid input, retrieval, updates, claim workflow and unauthorized access.
